The Analysis does not record the patterns (src/bridge.rs reads their members one by one, as oriented slots, and DERIVED_NOT_READ drops the patterns), so lint cannot tell a member from a lone slot and reports both sizes of each missing. Undetermined until draftwright decides #1430 and the maintainer decides whether the Analysis should carry oriented slot pattern membership (docs/rules/lint.yaml, LINT-oriented_slot_coverage-width_length).
